game: Hot Shots Tennis: Get a Grip
approach: Strict matching decompilation: every source in src/ compiles with the original compiler and, linked at its retail address, reproduces that function's retail bytes exactly, with nothing masked.
notes: Work in progress across the main game program and the Game Sharing module. The progress bar comes from the published objdiff report (docs/objdiff-report.json), written by tools/hstprogress.py from the same figures as the README: tier T1, functions that match exactly in isolation. Contains no game data, keys, decryption code or compilers; Sony SDK reconstructions are not published. Open to contributions (CONTRIBUTING.md); you build and verify against your own copy of the game.
